description_en: Queries the list of cloud services that support time series metrics in CloudMonitor
description_zh: 查询云监控支持的时序类监控项产品列表
name: QueryProjectMeta

parameters.help_en:
Filters results by labels. Format: `[{"name":"Label name","value":"Label value"},{"name":"Label name","value":"Label value"}]`.
Supported label names include product and groupFlag.
The product label value is the English name of the cloud service. 
The groupFlag label indicates whether the cloud service supports application groups. Valid values: true and false
parameters.help_zh:
根据标签过滤，格式为`[{"name":"标签名","value":"标签值"},{"name":"标签名","value":"标签值"}]`。
支持的标签名包括product、groupFlag。
product 标签值为产品英文名称。 
groupFlag含义为该产品是否支持应用分组，标签值为true或false
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Default value: 30
parameters.name: page_size
